patthana9.14:1.1: nokilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saṅkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.14:3.1: asaṅkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana9.14:4.1: asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kilesasampayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.14:6.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kilesañceva na asaṅkilesikañca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.14:8.1: na nocakilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kilesañceva na asaṅkiliṭṭhañca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.14:10.1: na nocakilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kilesañceva na kilesavippayuttañca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca.. na kilesavippayuttañceva na nocakilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca... na kilesavippayuttaṃ na saṅkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana9.14:11.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ na asaṅkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... piṭṭhiduka nakusalattikaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
